services.title: DentaQuest Prior Authorization Check
services.description: Evaluates a dental service order at sign-time and returns a card if prior authorization is required under Texas Medicaid Adult Dental.

services.title: DentaQuest Prior Authorization Check — Root Canal, Build-Up, Crown
services.description: Evaluates a dental treatment-plan order at sign-time and returns a card if prior authorization is required for D3320, D2950 or D2740 under Texas Medicaid Dental, naming the documentation required (clinical notes and radiographs).
